description: This file defines an abstract class 'Zend_XmlRpc_Value' that represents XML-RPC values within the Zend Framework. It includes constants for XML-RPC data types, methods for creating, parsing, and converting XML-RPC values, and mechanisms for generating and handling XML serialization.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value
classes.description: An abstract class representing a native XML-RPC value with methods for type management, XML serialization, and factory creation of various XML-RPC value objects.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the XML-RPC data type of the current value object.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the XML generator used to produce XML output.

methods.name: setGenerator
methods.description: Sets a custom XML generator instance.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Changes the encoding used by the XML generator.

methods.name: getXmlRpcValue
methods.description: Factory method to create an XML-RPC value object based on a PHP variable, XML string, or explicit type.

methods.name: getXmlRpcTypeByValue
methods.description: Determines the XML-RPC type name for a given PHP variable.

methods.name: _phpVarToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Converts a PHP variable to its corresponding XML-RPC native value object.

methods.name: _xmlStringToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Parses an XML string or SimpleXMLElement to produce an XML-RPC value object.

methods.name: _createSimpleXMLElement
methods.description: Helper function to create a SimpleXMLElement from a string if needed.

methods.name: _extractTypeAndValue
methods.description: Extracts the type and value information from a SimpleXMLElement representing an XML-RPC value.

methods.name: _setXML
methods.description: Sets the internal XML string representation of the value, removing XML declaration.
